tagline: Universal取景器相机，1938 年发布
description: Universal于1938年推出的取景器相机。配备Ilex Vitar f7.9/50mm on telescopic lens tube。快门速度single speed shutter with modes I(nstant), B(ulb) and T(ime)。使用"No. 00 Universal film" rolls / 28×38mm。

specs.镜头: Ilex Vitar f7.9/50mm on telescopic lens tube
specs.快门: single speed shutter with modes I(nstant), B(ulb) and T(ime)
